definitions.gloss: influential person; person of power; notable figure
definitions.explanation: A person who holds significant influence, power, or authority in a community, organization, or field.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}に{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted a local person of influence.

examples.japanese: {政界|せいかい}の{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}が{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Influential figures in politics gathered together.

examples.japanese: その{事業|じぎょう}は{地域|ちいき}の{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}の{支援|しえん}を{受|う}けて{成功|せいこう}した。
examples.english: The project succeeded with the support of influential people in the region.

notes:
Built from {有力|ゆうりょく} (influential, powerful) + {者|しゃ} (person). Refers to someone who holds significant sway in a community, organization, or political sphere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地元|じもと}の{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: local person of influence
- {政界|せいかい}の{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: political heavyweight
- {財界|ざいかい}の{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: influential figure in the business world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: person of real power (emphasizes actual ability)
- {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}: person in authority (emphasizes formal power)
- {名士|めいし}: notable figure, distinguished person (emphasizes reputation)

REGISTER:
A formal word. More common in news, political discussion, and written Japanese than in casual conversation.
